name: Crowded-attention LEVEL fade — short the exhaustion blow-off (1d)
rationale: MECHANISM: social_attention_z is the within-asset z of the LEVEL of social_volume. A SUSTAINED elevated level means the crowd is already all-in, so forward return is negative and worsens with horizon (internal prior: level leads DOWN). This is the exhaustion/blow-off side — late retail and influencer amplification mark the top; the other side is anyone selling into the euphoria. This is the LEVEL (not the CHANGE), and the SHORT side, making it economically distinct from the accel-long specs. Confirm exhaustion with an overbought RSI so we fade a stretched top, not a healthy trend. DISCONFIRMER: the internal note flags this replicated weakly — the negative forward return at high level-z must NOT be just RSI/overbought mean-reversion; if price-only overbought explains it, KILL. Shorting crypto incurs funding/borrow — must be net-positive after real short costs (funding leg wired). Exit when the crowd level normalizes.
catalyst: sustained crowd-attention level extreme into overbought — blow-off top
